description: A wemix network composed on the ORDINARY path crosses the croissant fork: the wemix producer seals to the block before it and stops, and the four go-wbft nodes that were endpoints until then take over block production. The handoff composer reaches the same end through its own bring-up; this is the same fork through place, keys, genesis, config, build, deploy, init and start, which is what lets a hardfork be declared rather than have a composer of its own.
